plan.scope: Offline opt-in working-view candidate only. No change to frozen sources, actual controller selection, endpoint reader, or acceptance.
plan.rule: Keep native seen, foreground and sheet guards. Use the same half-open window as the material check. Retain a veto for any existing occupied bin at or beyond the original guarded first bin if at least one of its native contributing rays lies inside the window; never count a bin with no in-window contributor. Retain even a single in-window ray of a mixed occupied bin as a conservative veto. Apply the same predicate to candidate proof and lateral scan recovery.
plan.gate: Reproduce all 28-30 native estimates with exact captured state; then require full unchanged 28 and 29 estimates and direct current slit or bank_slit on tick 30 with valid tool and material mapping, never memory. Compare physical and working chart labels only offline and report disagreement. Synthetic tests must cover wholly out-of-window bins at both ends, boundary equality, mixed bins with retained in-window deep or missing support, and intact material/foreground failures. This candidate does not prove an endpoint, authorize any motion, or change the 1/4 matrix.
